title: Research: P104 Y0 needs 48 new helper lifetimes, and 48 suffice
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

P104's geometric two-hyperplane cover does not supply the source values it needs. In the retained-source-path monotone relay model, completing Y0 requires **exactly 48 new helper lifetimes**. Each of its 48 correction sources leaves Y0's endpoint subspace on its first frame expansion; contributing reads must occur on 48 distinct, incomparable initial lines. The written causal-path argument permits arbitrary relays, rational cancellation, retiming and relaxed restoration.

A matching chronological word starts with 48 independent dirty helpers, acquires the sources at original cut 0, combines them in the two hyperplanes recorded by PR #2353, and delivers at original cut 3467. Exactly two helpers enter the target endpoint. All helper logical inputs restore. Y0 becomes `y0 + x0`; the other 103 target rows remain the original `G/2` channel.

Only `research/p104-y0-source-acquisition/` is added: proof, literal circuit, generator, exact receipt, two separate checkers and package metadata. Added invoice: **52 H1 + 46 H2 + 48 H6**, 146 transports, rank mass **432**, and **238 scalar ADDs** (142 unit, 96 half coefficients). The whole partial word has 4,442 events, 328 independent inputs and rank mass 2,800.

This is a scoped proof and finite common-chart construction. It is not a complete supplier or new κ. The 432 mass is sharp only when every new lifetime must run ZERO to FULL and transports cost their dimension gaps. It is productive boundary progress, not automatically recursive excess cost. The 48-lifetime bound must **not** be multiplied by 104: acquisition feeders can be shared across targets. Native phases/lowering, global owners, residual charges, precision and all-size admission remain open.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3, standard library, no third-party dependencies:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/p104-y0-source-acquisition/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/p104-y0-source-acquisition/crosscheck.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-y0-source-acquisition --check-only
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-y0-source-acquisition
```

All pass. Primary expected output:

```text
PASS_P104_Y0_SOURCE_ACQUISITION lifetimes=48 arrivals=2 columns=328 added_rank=432 added_ADD=238 controls=10 no_new_kappa
```

The primary checker uses sparse rational rows and enumerated binary subspaces. The second uses dense integer rows at exact scale 8, checks every division, and uses binary Gaussian elimination. They independently reconstruct all 328 endpoint columns and agree on the complete endpoint digest. Both are AI-assisted implementations, not separate human reviews.

Nine rejecting controls cover missing dirty compensation, capture, unmerge or cleanup; wrong source frame, transport charge, delivery timing, source-escape premise or cover assignment. A positive changed-source-path example shows one dirty helper can capture two sources when the crucial frame premise changes. Original 280-column replay is a positive baseline.

Circuit regeneration matches the complete parsed JSON. Both checkers pass in a Git-free read-only export; all 11 files remain unchanged. Source-byte drift, false receipt and occupied-output controls reject, preserving existing output. Registered replay takes about 1.2 seconds locally. Staged whitespace check passes. No native phase replay, full 104-target/global supplier replay, selected cold replay, precision/tape or all-size proof was run. Hosted CI and independent human review are not claimed.

The registered replay (with the dense cross-check) was run again on the final package bytes before submission, under an 8 GiB memory cap: it passed in about a second and left the worktree unchanged. The figures are consistent with the P104 geometry: Y0's correction support has 48 source labels, the construction adds 48 columns to the original 280 (328 in all), and 432 = 48 * 9.

## Open next questions

See README and `TASK.json`. The smallest useful mechanism step is two target covers sharing source-acquisition feeders, with actual common-frame contacts, a complete dirty-restored word and full pricing. The blocker is a compatible relay/owner schedule; summing one-target lower bounds is invalid. Native phase checking of this exact 146-transport word is a separate local obligation and would still leave 103 correction rows plus global admission.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The explicit one-target handoff in #2353 led directly to a bounded, source-bound result. Generic P104 searches are dominated by earlier work; narrow mechanism terms and exact current-status summaries were substantially more useful. A small machine-readable handoff specifying target, cover normals and the unproved acquisition condition would make this boundary faster to find.
